newsitem.title: CHINA: Sundiro sees '97 net at 250-300 mln yuan.
newsitem.headline: Sundiro sees '97 net at 250-300 mln yuan.

text.p: China's Hainan Sundiro Motorcycle Co Ltd expects net profit to reach 250-300 million yuan ($30.1-36.1 million) in 1997, up from 219 million yuan last year, a company official told Reuters on Tuesday.

Sundiro plans to boost output to 600,000-800,000 motorcyles this year from 350,000 in 1996, and sales are expected to reach 2.5-3.0 billion yuan this year from 1.6 billion yuan last year, the official said.

Sundiro, one of more than 30 enterprises approved by Beijing to issue foreign currency B shares, has said it plans to make an initial public offering of 150 million B shares in the first half of 1997.
